meta.title: PFAS amendments — experiment
meta.description: Explore, compare and cite amendments to the PFAS bill from a dated public Senate snapshot.

header.title: PFAS bill: explore and compare amendments
header.intro: Find the amendments to an article, compare their actual proposal texts, check the recorded outcome and open the official source. Official excerpts are shown in French, as published.

comparison.title: Lexical comparison
comparison.empty: Select two amendments to compare their proposal texts side by side.
comparison.one: Select one more amendment to compare.
comparison.disclaimer: Word-level differences between the two proposal texts. A lexical difference is not a claim about legal effect, scope or equivalence.
comparison.legendShared: Plain text: words found in both proposals, in the same order.
comparison.legendUnique: words found only in this proposal (announced to screen readers).
comparison.uniqueCount: {count, plural, =0 {No word unique to this proposal} one {# token unique to this proposal} other {# tokens unique to this proposal}}
comparison.tooLong: Texts too long for an in-browser comparison; full texts are shown without highlighting.
comparison.explanatoryHint: Shown separately: they state the authors' intent and are not compared.

export.local: Generated in your browser. Nothing is sent.

note.title: PFAS amendments {numbers}: sourced comparison
note.snapshotWarning: Dated public Senate snapshot, not current law and not a live import. Note generated
note.limitation1: This comparison is lexical only. It does not simulate legal or environmental outcomes and does not assess legal equivalence or scope.
note.limitation2: Outcomes are copied as recorded in the Senate export; no vote is inferred when none is recorded.
note.limitation3: The corpus is a dated snapshot of a 2023-2024 Senate stage. Check the official pages for later stages.
note.limitation4: Official texts are quoted in French without translation.
